title: Exploring heterometallic bridged Pt(II)-Zn(II) complexes as potential antitumor agents.
authors: Soldatovic, Tanja V; Smit, Biljana; Mrkalic, Emina M; Matic, Sanja Lj; Jelic, Ratomir M; Serafinovic, Marina Cendic; Gligorijevic, Nevenka; Cavic, Milena; Arandelovic, Sandra; Grguric-Sipka, Sanja
one_liner_zh: 该文研究异金属Pt(II)-Zn(II)配合物的抗肿瘤活性及与DNA的结合，属于小分子药物-DNA作用，无TF-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The four novel complexes [cis-PtCl(NH(3))(2)(mu-4,4'-bipyridyl)ZnCl(terpy)](ClO(4))(2) (C1), [trans-PtCl(NH(3))(2)(mu-4,4'-bipyridyl)ZnCl(terpy)](ClO(4))(2) (C2), [cis-PtCl(NH(3))(2)(mu-pyrazine)ZnCl(terpy)](ClO(4))(2) (C3) and [trans-PtCl(NH(3))(2)(mu-pyrazine)ZnCl(terpy)](ClO(4))(2) (C4) (where terpy = 2,2':6',2''-terpyridine) were synthesized and characterized. Acid-base titrations and concentration dependent kinetic measurements for the reactions with biologically relevant ligands such as guanosine-5'-monophosphate (5'-GMP), inosine-5'-monophosphate (5'-IMP) and glutathione (GSH), were studied at pH 7.4 and 37  degrees C. The binding of the heterometallic bridged cis- or trans-Pt(II)-Zn(II) complexes to calf thymus DNA (CT-DNA) was studied by UV absorption and fluorescence emission spectroscopy and molecular docking. The results indicated that the complexes bind strongly to DNA, through groove binding, hydrogen bonds, and hydrophobic or electrostatic interaction. The possible in vitro DNA protective effect of cis- and trans-Pt-L-Zn complexes has shown that C3 had significant dose-dependent DNA-protective effect and the same ability to inhibit peroxyl as well as hydroxyl radicals. Antiproliferative effect of the complexes, mRNA expression of apoptosis and repair-related genes after treatment in cancer cells indicated that newly synthesized C2 exhibited highly selective cytotoxicity toward colon carcinoma HCT116 cells. Only treatment with trans analog C2 induced effect similar to the typical DNA damaging agent such as cisplatin, characterized by p53 mediated cell response, cell cycle arrest and certain induction of apoptotic related genes. Both cis- and trans-isomers C1 and C2 showed potency to elicit expression of PARP1 mRNA and in vitro DNA binding.
abstract_zh: 合成了四种新型配合物[顺式-PtCl(NH(3))(2)(mu-4,4'-联吡啶)ZnCl(terpy)](ClO(4))(2) (C1)、[反式-PtCl(NH(3))(2)(mu-4,4'-联吡啶)ZnCl(terpy)](ClO(4))(2) (C2)、[顺式-PtCl(NH(3))(2)(mu-吡嗪)ZnCl(terpy)](ClO(4))(2) (C3)和[反式-PtCl(NH(3))(2)(mu-吡嗪)ZnCl(terpy)](ClO(4))(2) (C4)（其中terpy = 2,2'：6',2''-三联吡啶），并对其进行了表征。在pH 7.4和37摄氏度条件下，研究了与生物相关配体如鸟苷-5'-单磷酸（5'-GMP）、肌苷-5'-单磷酸（5'-IMP）和谷胱甘肽（GSH）反应的酸碱滴定和浓度依赖性动力学测量。通过紫外吸收和荧光发射光谱以及分子对接，研究了异金属桥联的顺式或反式Pt(II)-Zn(II)配合物与小牛胸腺DNA（CT-DNA）的结合。结果表明，这些配合物通过沟槽结合、氢键以及疏水或静电相互作用与DNA强结合。顺式和反式Pt-L-Zn配合物可能的体外DNA保护效应显示，C3具有显著的剂量依赖性DNA保护作用，并且具有与抑制过氧自由基和羟基自由基相同的能力。配合物的抗增殖效应、处理后癌细胞中凋亡和修复相关基因的mRNA表达表明，新合成的C2对结肠癌HCT116细胞表现出高度选择性细胞毒性。仅反式类似物C2处理诱导了类似于典型DNA损伤剂如顺铂的效应，其特征为p53介导的细胞反应、细胞周期阻滞和某些凋亡相关基因的诱导。顺式和反式异构体C1和C2均显示出引发PARP1 mRNA表达和体外DNA结合的效力。
